messages:
mia: heads-up — onboarded hf model salsa-7b-small this morning, ran quantize pipeline and noticed a downstream chat regression in our internal regression suite :thinking_face:

sam: what kind of regression? quality or runtime?

mia: quality. chat responses are dropping closing punctuation, sometimes truncating last sentence. perf looks fine. suspect token ids shifted somewhere during conversion/quantize.

chen: any diffs in tokenizer files? added_tokens.json / config.json?

mia: yup. quick diff showed added_tokens.json in hf repo had two visually identical entries — one with a regular space, one with NBSP (\u00A0). HF tokenizer normalized to NFC at save, so when our convert step appended added_tokens it ended up deduping differently between CPU-save and quantized binary write.

sam: can you paste the snippet?

mia: sure:

```json
// hf_repo/tokenizer/added_tokens.json
[
  "<|sys|>",
  "<|user|>",
  "<|assistant|>",
  "<|sep|>",
  "\u00A0<|pad|>"  // NBSP + token accidentally added by preproc script
]
```

mia: after our convert + quantize, tokenizer v2 ended up with pad token at a different id because the NBSP variant was removed by the dedupe pass but at a different stage than our index assignment. result: pad/unk/bos ids moved by +1 for entire tail.

viktor: ouch. so behavior differs between convert -> save_pretrained and quantize -> binary writer.

chen: can we repro deterministically? send command and model commit?

mia: repro branch: refs/heads/qa/salsa-onboard-dup-nbsp. repro steps:
```
git checkout refs/heads/qa/salsa-onboard-dup-nbsp
python tools/hf_to_redwood/convert_tokenizer.py --hf-dir ./hf_repo/tokenizer --out ./redwood_tokenizer
python tools/quantize/pack_weights.py --in model.pt --out model.q8.bt --tokenizer ./redwood_tokenizer
pytest tests/regressions/test_chat_format.py::test_trailing_punctuation -q
```

sam: got it. quick hack: patch convert to normalize whitespace (NFKC) on added_tokens before dedupe and persist explicit mapping file token_map.json that maps hf_id -> redwood_id.

chen: also check config.json: our convert currently falls back to default bos/eos/pad names if keys missing. hf config used "pad_token": "<|pad|>" but tokenizer had alias "<pad>". mismatch caused our fallback to create bos/eos as incremental tokens.

mia: exactly. the combination of name aliasing + unicode dup + dedupe ordering is what produced the id drift.

viktor: ops-bot shows a deploy for the quantized model at 09:12 — we should rollback served version until patch. @ops-bot can you hold traffic? :pray:

ops-bot: Deployment paused for model salsa-7b-small-q8 at 09:15 UTC. Canary traffic disabled.

sam: proposed fix checklist:
- normalize added_tokens entries with NFKC and trim whitespace
- preserve explicit token order by writing added_tokens_canonical.json and refusing conversion if canonicalization changes count without explicit confirmation
- emit token_map.json from convert step so pack_weights uses stable ids instead of recomputing
- update quantize writer to accept token_map override to keep ids stable when dedupe occurs

chen: tests to add:
- end-to-end hf->redwood conversion roundtrip assert tokenizer.vocab ids equal after convert+quantize with map override
- regression test for trailing punctuation in chat (existing suite) flagged as must-fail before fix

mia: I started a PR with the normalization + token_map output: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4723 — it has a failing test illustrating the issue.

sam: nice. can we also add a lint to detect control or non-breaking spaces in added_tokens on HF side? easier for model owners to fix upstream.

mia: yes, added to PR notes. sending a note to model-onboarding channel to inspect existing repos for NBSPs.

viktor: once PR merged, I'll coordinate a canary redeploy and run the regression suite. if green, promote.

chen: one more gotcha: chat templates in hf_model_card used tokens like "<s>" for bos but model's tokenizer used "<|sys|>". we should prefer tokenizer.special_tokens_map to populate template placeholders during convert rather than trusting model_card.

mia: added that to PR too.

sam: summary: root cause = unicode/aliasing + dedupe ordering differences between HF save and our quantize writer -> token id drift -> subtle chat truncation/regression. fix = canonicalize, emit stable mapping, and prefer tokenizer's special token map for chat templates. :white_check_mark:

mia: thanks all — will follow up when PR merged and canary passes. :rocket:
